title: Ordinary integral models assemble from supplied stratum models
statement: Let ℓ be prime and E a finite-dimensional normed ℚ_ℓ-algebra which is a normed field. Use the coefficients and inclusion O_E,X→E_X of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients] and internal modules of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. Let X be a scheme with noetherian underlying space, F an internal E_X-module, and S a finite constructible locally closed stratification of X [def-constructible-stratification]. Suppose that for every immersion i_a:Y_a→X of S, one is supplied with an internal i_a⁻¹O_E,X-module N_a constructible on Y_a and an isomorphism from its ordinary scalar extension along i_a⁻¹(O_E,X→E_X) to i_a⁻¹F. Then there exists a constructible internal O_E,X-module N whose ordinary scalar extension is isomorphic to F. The conclusion does not assert that the specified N_a themselves glue without rescaling.

proof.text: Use Topology.Stratification.exists_chain_opens from WeilConjectures.ConstructibleSheaf.Devissage to obtain a finite increasing chain from the empty open to X, with each successive difference contained in a stratum. Its existing noetherian induction and dense-open-stratum argument also handle the empty space and the empty stratification.

For each open V take the image subobject of the counit V_! V^* F to F. Prove this counit monic using the fully faithful inclusion of the open pro-etale site: at objects in its image the Kan-extension unit is invertible, and at the other objects the relevant comma category is empty. The linear and condensed module counits inherit monicity. Use the existing Adjunction.exists_iso_counit_app for composed restrictions to make these subobjects increasing. The first is zero, the last is F. The existing Subobject.cokernelOfLEMkIso identifies each quotient with the outer open extension of the cokernel for the inclusion of two successive opens.

For a difference W minus W0 contained in the stratum immersion i, take its reduced closed complement Z inside W. Its map to X factors through i: lift to the coborder open of i and use the proved reduced-source factorization for the resulting closed immersion. Transport the supplied integral lattice across the condensed coefficient isomorphism, then pull it back to Z. Pullback preserves constructibility and commutes with coefficient extension.

Reuse the proved ordinary module support helpers openRestrictionPushforwardZero, openUnitIsIso, moduleCounitOfAbelian and moduleUnitOfAbelian from Sheaf.Paper.CondensedOpenClosedRecollement through a proof-only import all. Reuse constructible_of_restrictions and constructible_of_isZero from Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtaleModuleConstructibleExtensionByZero in the same way. Closed pushforward preserves constructibility by concatenating the closed stratification and the zero open stratification. An integral closed pushforward rationalizes to the desired supported rational module: coefficient extension commutes with open pullback, and its closed pullback is the supplied rational lattice by the closed counit. The supported unit identifies both modules with the closed pushforward of their equal closed restrictions. This avoids a filtered-colimit comparison for closed pushforward.

The cokernel of the inner open counit has zero open restriction. Its closed restriction is the restriction of F, since closed pullback kills open extension by zero and preserves cokernels. Apply the preceding supported-model construction, then extend that integral model along W into X. Open extension preserves constructibility and commutes with scalar extension by the ordinary coefficient comparison.

A constructible ordinary integral lattice in degree zero is bounded integral constructible, including zero cohomology in every other degree. Exactness of coefficient extension identifies its derived extension with the degree-zero rational graded piece. Every short exact subobject-cokernel sequence yields a distinguished triangle, so the triangulated integral image contains all stages of the finite filtration and hence F in degree zero.

Choose the resulting bounded integral constructible complex K. Its degree-zero homology is constructible, and the homology comparison for exact derived coefficient extension identifies ordinary extension of H0(K) with H0(F[0]) and hence F. All choices occur within the proof of existence; no object is defined from an unproved mere-existence theorem.

proof_origin.note: C1 repair: complete Lean proof by finite monic open-extension filtration, reduced closed-support lattice construction, triangulated essential-image induction, and H0 extraction. The eight duplicate lemmas identified by the return are removed: generic counit and topological filtration lemmas are reused from ConstructibleSheaf.Devissage; existing private module support and constructibility helpers are reused through proof-only import all. Also reuse the existing cokernel-of-subobject isomorphism and zero-constructibility theorem. A proved private canonical smallness instance and explicit applications of mono/epi-of-isomorphism lemmas prevent unrelated etale-devissage instances from causing inference timeouts. No new holes or public signatures.

lean.statement:
theorem continuousConstructible_integral_gluing (X : Scheme.{u})
    [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace X]
    (F : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
    (S : Scheme.Stratification X)
    (hmodels : ∀ a : Fin S.n,
      ∃ N : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (S.domain a)) Ab.{u + 1})
          ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (S.immersion a)).obj
            (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X)),
        ProEtale.IsConstructibleModuleObject
          ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (S.immersion a)).obj
            (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X)) N ∧
        Nonempty ((Mod.extendScalars
          ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (S.immersion a)).map
            (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X))).obj N ≅
          ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (S.immersion a)).mapMod
            (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X)).obj F)) :
    ∃ N : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
        (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X),
      ProEtale.IsConstructibleModuleObject (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X) N ∧
      Nonempty ((Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X)).obj N ≅ F)
